condo: Wow! C.H.E.A.P! Move-In Ready Brand New Freehold

history.summary: A 'brand new freehold' 3BR in D15 at $2.905M / $2,700 psf — despite the 'C.H.E.A.P' headline, $2,700 psf is among the highest PSF in the batch on a 1,076 sqft unit. No built year, no transaction data, weak score (341); the marketing copy is a red flag, not a discount.
history.rating_rationale: $2,700 psf is full top-of-market new-launch pricing — the 'cheap' headline is contradicted by the number. $2.905M 3BR is above the liquid band; 10-min/820m walk to MRT removes any transit premium. No built_year and no URA data make value unverifiable. score_1000 = 341 (near the batch floor) and a losing record (239-327). Nothing here supports an investment buy.
